semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Unipulse provides assistive devices that can be utilized in semiconductor manufacturing environments, particularly for handling heavy workpieces.
summary: Unipulse specializes in assistive lifting devices, such as the Electric Balancer Moon Lifter, designed to facilitate the movement and positioning of heavy workpieces in semiconductor manufacturing and other industries. Their products enhance safety and efficiency by reducing physical strain on workers and enabling precise handling of delicate components.
capabilities: Electric Balancer Moon Lifter for lifting and moving workpieces
Silicone-free load cells for semiconductor manufacturing
JibMoon combining lifting and jib capabilities
